title: Geometric Linguistic Transformations in Transformer Latent Spaces
description: Research code, result tables, figures, and draft papers for experiments on linguistic transformation geometry in transformer embedding spaces. This release preserves the current evidence package for endpoint controls, multiseed ablations, hard-holdout boundary analyses, signed-permutation diagnostics, semantic-equivalence controls, and cross-model transfer roadmaps. The repository is an active research artifact, not a peer-reviewed publication.
